# Pillar RSK01: Excess drawdown path (merged)
Definition: Mean of three one-sided sub-scores over the same expanding window (at least 10 years, monthly USD, spliced under ELG07, ^NDX for the Nasdaq-100 before 1999):
- raw excess maximum drawdown against the world reference (not beta-scaled), k = 10 points;
- raw excess time under water (RSK02), k = 24 months;
- beta-adjusted stress-window shortfall (RSK04, FAC05 beta), k = 5 points.
The beta-scaled excess drawdown is also logged in REC02 for comparison. VWRA and anything calmer score 50. Weight 0.35 of RSK (14% of X), which keeps the drawdown cluster within 15% of X.
Source: yfinance .L and proxy monthly returns; ^NDX (verified); Ken French market series for splices; world reference per ELG07 (verified). Better when: lower excess (one-sided). Informs: portfolio_mix.
Week 2026-W46.
